title: The Phil Harris-Alice Faye Show
paragraphs: NBC comedy/situation-comedy and music vehicle starring fictionalized versions of Phil Harris and Alice Faye with a recurring family, band and supporting cast. Frozen GRH snapshot contains 252 objects including three reference tracks, a July 1946 audition and an October 1953 rehearsal/unedited tape.

GRH documents the program through Fitch Bandwagon: Phil Harris-Alice Faye era (September 29, 1946 to May 23, 1948) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], Phil Harris-Alice Faye Show: Rexall era (October 3, 1948 to June 4, 1950) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], and Phil Harris-Alice Faye Show: RCA era (October 1, 1950 to June 18, 1954) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Elliott Lewis (performer on 212 recordings), Phil Harris (performer on 212 recordings), Alice Faye (performer on 211 recordings), Bill Forman (announcer on 210 recordings), Walter Tetley (performer on 208 recordings), Anne Whitfield (performer on 198 recordings), and Jeanine Roos (performer on 197 recordings).

The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] (broadcast on network), [[org|org.cd82fd99edb39caa|Armed Forces Radio and Television Service]] (rebroadcast by), and [[org|org.4798d1172deaae2c|Armed Forces Radio Service]] (rebroadcast by).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include music, bands and performance, family and domestic life, money, shopping and household finances, radio work and broadcasting, pets and animals, and travel and vacation.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Postwar domestic and family situation comedy, Commercial sponsorship in network radio comedy, and Hollywood celebrity adapted to radio domestic comedy.

Programs with especially strong personnel connections in the GRH knowledge graph include [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]] (61 shared credited people), [[show|screen-directors-playhouse|Screen Directors Playhouse]] (44 shared credited people), [[show|the-railroad-hour|The Railroad Hour]] (40 shared credited people), [[show|the-whistler|The Whistler]] (37 shared credited people), and [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]] (36 shared credited people).
